A1.justification: Both PDFs describe OmniSVG and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–B. Corresponding content can be matched despite rewriting and relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results, parameterization and architecture ablations, character-reference evaluations and a user study in Section 5.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 3–7 and the appendix analysis of character-data generation.

M1.justification: The six-command SVG representation, coordinate-token mapping, Qwen2.5-VL architecture, next-token objective and sampling procedure remain unchanged. Section 4 reorganizes their explanation without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MMSVG icon, illustration and character coverage and three generation tasks. Although v2 removes FIGR-8-SVG from the main benchmark description, Appendix B.1 retains its use. Stylization is proposed only as future work.

E2.justification: Tables 3 and 7 retain VectorFusion, SVGDreamer, Chat2SVG, IconShop, LIVE, DiffVG, GPT-4o and StarVector in the corresponding comparisons. The model-size and architecture comparator sets also remain unchanged. Newly cited works are not newly evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, 200 × 200 preprocessing, evaluation metrics, 250-billion-token training budget, model configurations and 64-SVG user-study design remain unchanged. The additional keyword detail in Appendix A.3 does not establish revised experiments or regenerated data.

E4.justification: Both retain the coordinate/color, model-size and VLM-architecture ablations, natural-image failure examples and Figure 11's Redux downsampling analysis. Their questions, comparisons and supporting evidence are unchanged.

E5.justification: Table 1's token-length spread summaries are unchanged. Neither version introduces repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or other new uncertainty-reporting procedures.

E6.justification: Tables 3–7 retain identical scores, timings, token counts and rankings. The approximately 7-point GPT-4o character-reference score, qualitative examples and Figure 11's token/path counts also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The path and command definitions, coordinate mapping x × w + y and likelihood objective in Equation 1 are mathematically unchanged. Neither appendix adds or revises formal assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: v2 removes the introduction's 'first unified framework' and 'first family' priority claims and changes the stated SVG capacity from 'up to 30k' to 'exceeding 30k' tokens. The central method, dataset and performance contributions remain.

C2.justification: Section 2 removes the specific causal criticism that StarVector's separated text/image understanding produces poor alignment. The main result interpretations and limitations concerning natural images and generation time remain unchanged; stylization is newly mentioned as future work.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3 newly specifies motion and expression keywords in the existing character-data pipeline. Section 2 also drops the explicit 'full public access' assurance while retaining the project link. These are documentation changes; the PDFs do not establish data rebuilding or actual withdrawal of access.

R1.justification: v2 adds seven works concerning data construction, human rendering and stylization, including Step1x-3D and StyleMe3D, and removes the latent-diffusion reference. Related-work positioning is condensed and the priority claim narrowed, without a substantial expansion of literature analysis.

P1.justification: The introductory positioning, related-work discussion, benchmark descriptions and tokenizer exposition undergo substantial rewriting and consolidation. Related-work subsections are reordered, tokenization details move out of the architecture explanation, and dataset headings are renamed. v2 also adds Fukun Yin to the authors and fixes the broken Figure 9 reference.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables retain their visual content and structures, but several change placement. Figure 3 switches columns, the ablation displays are rearranged, Table 8 moves within the appendix, and the appendix begins alongside the conclusion instead of on a separate page.

improvement.justification: v2 separates the tokenizer and architecture explanations more clearly, reduces repetition in Sections 2–4, fixes the limitation-figure reference and adds a small data-generation detail. These provide a limited improvement in clarity and documentation. The empirical support is unchanged, and removal of the public-access assurance slightly weakens access documentation without establishing an actual availability change.
